critique: The warm orange particle color, deep black background, and soft oversized bloom read correctly as a Glow Field. Density is improved versus the prior render, especially at t4, but t1 remains too open and sparse, with broad empty black areas between isolated lights. The field also still builds noticeably from t1 to t4 rather than reading as a consistently populated ambient texture. A few very large glows dominate while there are not enough smaller supporting points to form a rich field.

suggestions.why: Raise particle emission substantially so both sampled times contain many more supporting lights and the field reads as a dense glow texture rather than scattered individual dots.
Slightly reduce the maximum particle size so increased emission fills the frame with more balanced small-to-medium glows instead of letting a few oversized blooms dominate.
